scope: Read-only review of existing official terms and robots URLs. No course details, platform APIs, browser actions, playback, account use, production writes, or historical report edits.

network_budget.note: The web tool provides retrieved/indexed text and crawl labels, not raw HTTP traces. Four URL reads must not be represented as four independently observed origin HTTP 200 responses.

production_policy.constant_name_note: The repository uses PLATFORM_POLICY_REVIEWS; no OFFICIAL_SITE_POLICIES identifier was used for this audit.

bilibili.guard_meaning: A pre-request application policy decision; not an HTTP rejection observed on a Bilibili course/video page today. The unreviewed-host allowlist cannot override this permission-required state.

terms.interpretation: Title-only tool result. Cause unknown; this is not proof of a 403, CAPTCHA, login requirement, or a whole-site browser-access failure.

historical_clause.paraphrase: The historical official-domain review records a prior express written-permission requirement for automated acquisition of service, content, or data. The project records no such permission.
historical_clause.historical_method: Official-domain search returned agreement text; direct opening already had no readable body then.

robots.interpretation: The retrieved robots text does not prohibit every /video/ path. Robots rules do not override a separate service-terms requirement or establish permission for automated aggregation.

icourse163.guard_meaning: The application currently stops automatic metadata collection because its integration permission scope remains unconfirmed. This is not a declaration that public human browsing is prohibited, and is not an observed HTTP refusal today.

clauses.paraphrase: Public course-information browsing is described; watching or studying a course is described as requiring account login.
Plugins, add-ons, and other third-party tools or services connecting to the platform and related systems are subject to prior written-permission restrictions.
Site content and course materials remain subject to intellectual-property and reuse restrictions.

terms.interpretation: These clauses distinguish browsing a public course introduction from a production automatic metadata integration. This audit does not resolve or expand the latter permission scope. It does not treat policy_unreviewed as a permanent categorical ban.

robots.interpretation: The tool did not expose an origin HTTP status. Do not convert this result to 404, 403, CAPTCHA, or site-wide denial.

conclusion: Keep observed browser course-page access and directory findings in the separate parent-task evidence. Neither application policy result is evidence of a new origin HTTP rejection. No production policy or allowlist was changed.
